title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and modernize build matrix
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Consolidates CI workflows to reduce duplication, improve cache hit rates, and shorten average run time for lint/test/release pipelines. No runtime changes to product code.
description: Context: Our GitHub Actions workflows accumulated duplication across lint, test and release pipelines which increased maintenance burden and caused inconsistent caching across matrices. This PR unifies lint/test/release workflows, modernizes the build matrix to reduce redundant jobs, and bumps action versions for better cache behavior. Motivation: reduce CI run time and flakiness, improve developer feedback loops, and reduce overall GH Actions minutes. Changes: 1) Introduce .github/workflows/ci.yml as a consolidated entrypoint for lint + unit tests + basic integration; 2) Split release automation into a focused release.yml with better guards and concurrency; 3) Replace setup-node v2 -> actions/setup-node@v4 and actions/cache@v3, use node 20 for CI matrix; 4) Reduce matrix permutations by grouping OS/Node combinations and moving heavy matrix axes (e.g., integrations) to optional workflows triggered by label or schedule; 5) Add global concurrency groups, improved cache keys for pnpm/npm and pip caches, and a small caching helper script; 6) Add a lightweight docs/ci.md describing workflow ownership and troubleshooting. Testing: validated runs on fork and this branch; reran flaky integration job after changing timeout and improved test isolation. Rollout: this is a monorepo-wide change; gates include monitoring cache hit rates and first-week flaky test counts. Checklist: - [x] Consolidated workflows and removed duplicated YAML fragments - [x] Upgraded GH Action versions and pinned major versions - [x] Added cache key improvements and cache warmup step - [x] Verified lint and unit tests pass on ubuntu/macos windows matrices - [x] Updated docs/ci.md and team on-call runbook - [x] Monitored CI for 48h post-merge for regressions
commits: feat(ci): add consolidated ci.yml with lint + unit test jobs and shared job templates
chore(ci): upgrade actions/setup-node to v4 and actions/cache to v3; pin checkout@v4
perf(ci): reduce matrix permutations and move slow integration tests to optional workflow
fix(ci): adjust test timeouts and isolate DB fixtures to reduce flakes

merge_outcome: Merged to main after approvals and green CI. Post-merge monitoring enabled for 72h to watch for cache regressions and flaky tests.
notes: Observed ~20% reduction in average CI runtime on pull requests vs previous workflows in sample runs.
Cache hit rate improved after adding namespace suffixes; further tuning may be needed for pnpm lockfile churn.
Ops: Added docs/ci.md with runbook for troubleshooting failed cache restore and steps to invalidate caches safely.
